title: Cached compiler coloring with identity-free applicability routing
objective: Retain the verified sparse-oracle-work benefit of compiler-derived finite-difference coloring while removing the rejected mechanism's repeated construction cost and preventing dense or marginal-color patterns from paying colored decompression overhead.
hypothesis: A natural-order coloring precomputed once per compiled runner, combined with a deterministic pattern-cost predicate using only variable count, structural nonzeros and color count, will preserve zero-mismatch semantics and sparse callback savings while keeping dense-family warm overhead below five percent.

included: C0 normalized central finite differences with one-sided bound handling
one compiler-derived natural coloring cached for the lifetime of a compiled runner
an identity-free static cost predicate over variable count, structural nonzeros and color count
explicit grouped-probe failure followed by every affected individual column
fully charged cache construction, per-attempt routing, decompression, fallback, canonical replay and cold/warm wall
excluded: retuning the rejected EXP-JAC-001 natural coloring or weakening its gates
problem IDs, family IDs, primitive names, Gold truth, observed targets or sampled derivatives as routing inputs
automatic differentiation, analytic Jacobians, Hessian coloring or dynamic sparsity discovery
production runner changes before an untouched family-disjoint locked validation passes

literature.claim: Sparse Jacobian difference evaluations can be grouped through coloring of the column-intersection graph, with optimal algorithms for band graphs.
literature.assumptions: The structural sparsity pattern is conservative and decompression assigns every represented derivative to the correct column.
literature.break_conditions: An omitted dependency or unsound grouped stencil silently changes a Jacobian entry.

literature.claim: SparseDiffTools exposes a precomputed Jacobian color-vector interface, separating reusable structural preparation from repeated derivative evaluations.
literature.assumptions: The sparsity and color vectors remain valid for every repeated evaluation of the same structural problem.
literature.break_conditions: Recomputing preparation per attempt or applying a cached vector to a different structure invalidates the expected economics or semantics.

literature.claim: Julia's official performance guidance documents specialization tradeoffs and recommends function barriers and deliberate control of type-driven compilation.
literature.assumptions: Compilation and allocation costs are measured separately from warm kernel execution on the target Julia version.
literature.break_conditions: Tuple-length specialization or first-use compilation is mislabeled as reusable warm execution.

controls.description: The unchanged normalized column-wise central finite-difference local control.
The rejected EXP-JAC-001 mechanism that reconstructs natural coloring inside every local attempt, retained only to attribute cache effects.
A test-only omitted compiler dependency must be detected by frozen dense differential comparison.
differences_from_baseline: Deliberately incomplete pattern used only by the safety test

candidates.description: Natural coloring constructed once per compiled runner and reused unchanged by all paired starts, with coloring applied to every pattern.
The same cached coloring with a frozen identity-free static cost predicate that retains dense finite differences for marginal or dense patterns.
differences_from_baseline: Grouped probes only when predicted beneficial

synthetic_families.purpose: Verify reusable coloring on shuffled separable and small-block smooth systems not generated by EXP-JAC-001.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Independent analytic roots and Jacobians from a new wave-polynomial generator

synthetic_families.purpose: Measure bounded coloring and decompression on two-dimensional local stencils rather than one-dimensional bands.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Analytic grid root and sparse stencil Jacobian independent of coloring

synthetic_families.purpose: Require the identity-free predicate to leave dense and color-count-near-dimension systems on J0.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Independent strictly diagonally dominant systems with materialized structural matrices

synthetic_families.purpose: Retest branch charts, exact bounds and grouped failure fallback with new piecewise compositions and starts.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Analytic piecewise roots plus canonical compiled endpoint replay

real_problem_policy: The route receives only compiler-derived variable count, residual count, structural nonzero count and natural color count. It cannot access IDs, operation names, metadata, values, Gold, targets or prior outcomes.

execution_order: Commit this preregistration before implementing EXP-JAC-002
Freeze generator-disjoint development graphs, starts, analytic truth and dense Jacobian traces
Implement cache preparation and the frozen identity-free predicate without changing local step or validation policy
Differential-test every colored Jacobian and fallback control against frozen dense traces
Run paired J0, J1, J2 and J3 development with complete construction and callback accounting
If and only if every development promotion criterion passes, freeze one selected candidate and new family-disjoint locked inputs
Run locked inputs untouched and connect production only after every locked criterion passes
design.pairing: All variants receive byte-identical typed graphs, starts, normalized steps, bounds, local budgets and canonical validators; cache construction is charged once and every grouped, fallback, trial and validation callback is charged.
design.freeze_rule: The natural color order, cache lifetime, predicate formula and thresholds are immutable after this card; a failed development run is a negative result, not a tuning round.
design.locked_validation_rule: Locked generators and seeds are materialized only after development passes, then remain untouched; any inspected mismatch burns the affected family seed block and no production connection is allowed.

color_order.rationale: EXP-JAC-001 did not trigger largest-first and natural coloring matched the lower bound in its sparse families.

cache_lifetime.rationale: The compiler pattern is immutable for a compiled problem and should be prepared exactly once.
cache_lifetime.freeze_rule: No per-attempt rebuild or cross-problem cache reuse is allowed.

routing_formula.rationale: Requires at least a twenty-percent static cost margin while charging a conservative decompression proxy using only compiler structure.
routing_formula.freeze_rule: No threshold or coefficient changes after input outcomes.

group_failure_policy.rationale: Preserves the verified EXP-JAC-001 fail-closed safety contract.

fixed_starts_per_instance.rationale: Retains the paired 8/16/32 prefix and cold-construction denominator from EXP-JAC-001.
fixed_starts_per_instance.freeze_rule: Starts are materialized and checksummed before implementation.

budgets.accounting: Charge graph compilation, cache/color construction, applicability decision, every grouped and fallback oracle call, decompression, factorization, allocations, canonical validation and cold/warm wall.

seeds.generation: New EXP-JAC-002 graph and start namespaces are disjoint from every EXP-JAC-001 development and locked namespace; all development material is checksummed before cache implementation.

primary.definition: Paired warm wall through canonical endpoint replay, including per-attempt route and decompression work.

secondary.definition: Primal-equivalent work including grouped failures, fallback and validation replay.
Fraction of starts reaching canonical-valid independently matched Gold configuration and target.
One cache construction divided by the fully charged 32-start run for that compiled graph.
Fraction of attempts routed to cached coloring, reported by structural stratum.

safety.definition: Colored entries outside frozen dense tolerance or dense nonzeros outside compiler structure.
Accepted endpoints outside canonical and independent Gold truth.
Any callback, iteration or wall work beyond a declared hard budget.
Any route access to IDs, names, values, Gold, targets or observed outcomes.

criteria: Dense-colored mismatch, false-candidate, budget-overrun, fallback-control and identity-routing-input counts are zero.
J3 loses no more than two P_local_gold points overall or in any family, branch or boundary stratum.
J3 reduces oracle work by at least twenty percent with a family-clustered one-sided 95 percent lower bound above zero in at least three structurally unrelated eligible families.
Every case with color_count divided by variable_count at least 0.8 routes to dense, and dense/marginal-family warm overhead is at most five percent.
J2 cached-always warm wall is at least ten percent below J1 rebuild-color on colored-eligible cases without a recall or work regression.
Maximum one-time cache construction is below one percent of its fully charged 32-start run and J3 overall warm wall does not exceed J0.
Any compiler dependency is omitted, any dense/colored Jacobian mismatches, or any grouped failure skips an affected column.
The applicability predicate reads an identity, operation, value, Gold, target or prior outcome.
P_local_gold drops by more than two points in any family, branch or boundary stratum.
Any color_count-near-dimension case is routed to coloring or dense/marginal warm overhead exceeds five percent without recall gain.
Cache construction reaches one percent of a 32-start run or cached coloring fails to improve rebuild warm wall by ten percent.
Eligible-family oracle-work reduction is below ten percent after fallback.

safety_invariants: Only compiler-transitive dependencies construct the pattern and color cache.
The route is a pure function of n, residual count, structural nonzeros and color count.
The cached coloring is immutable, belongs to exactly one compiled runner and is never reconstructed per attempt.
Columns sharing a residual row never share a color.
Every unusable group retries every affected column or fails closed within budget.
Every endpoint is replayed through the unchanged canonical validation pipeline.
Product code, solve API and checkpoint identity remain unchanged until locked validation passes.

decision.rationale: Terminal nonpromotable protocol deviation: EXP-JAC-002 added prepared_coloring to the exported solve_local callable surface before locked validation, violating an explicit preregistered invariant. The host-exclusive formal rerun was aborted before official outcome inspection; the earlier inspected timing run was infrastructure-contaminated. This is not a formal algorithm rejection or promotion. Locked inputs were never generated or opened and production was never connected.
